caveats: The brain overruns its tick on some ticks (84-111 ms of work against a 90 ms deadline at NODE_TICKRATE=150) and the encoder drive goes stale on those. It applies equally to every condition so it cannot bias the contrast; `overrun_fraction` is per condition.

The decoded drive sits near 0.10 with a steering differential of about +/-0.1 rad, so directed movement is slow and the steering metrics (distance, tortuosity) are correspondingly noisy. Zero kills in every condition is a result about the decoder's dynamic range, not a broken harness.
